name: basic
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Canonical form, Fields. 0030: a hash of the section's structured content in a fixed order.

name: full
source: Hand-written. Every field of every type is set, with a source that must be left out, and an env entry with an empty value. Contract rules: the key order tables, Fields. 0030: it excludes source.

name: strings
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Strings. Quote, backslash, tab, carriage return, newline, other control characters, DEL, the three characters a JSON library may escape, and characters outside ASCII.

name: values
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Values, Conditions. The Value kinds are from the domain model. The Text unknown-yet is a word from 0030 and the domain model, and differs from the Unknown kind.

name: unknown-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Unknown fields. 0030: unknown fields are kept on a section. Keys are out of order in the input, and include digits, upper case, a non-ASCII letter, and a key that needs escaping. Decimals that a library may write with an exponent.

name: source-ignored
source: 0030: the hash excludes source. One section with no source, and the same section with three different sources, one of them empty.

name: unknown-key-order
source: 0030: the hash is of structured content, so key order in the file does not change it. Contract rule: Unknown fields, keys in ascending byte order.

name: omitted-zero
source: Contract rule: Zero values. Every zero field of a section, a variable, and a step is written out, as an empty string, false, an empty list, an empty map, or null, and the hash is the same as when the fields are absent.

name: list-order
source: 0030: a fixed order of content, and the order of a list is content. The first section has every kind of list. Each other section swaps two items of one list, or repeats an item. Contract rule: Lists.

name: absent-and-default
source: Contract rules: Defaults, Conditions. The hasher fills no default, and a present empty condition is not an absent one.

name: body-whitespace
source: Contract rule: Strings. Reformatting means the file's layout, so whitespace inside a string is content. 0030: raw text is not hashed, the structured content is.

name: field-boundaries
source: Contract rule: Canonical form. Two sections with different content never share a canonical form. Text moves between neighbouring fields, items, and keys, and an unknown field takes the name of a known one.

name: value-kinds
source: Contract rule: Values. A Value is written by its kind. Absent, Flag, Text, Unknown, and List are all different, whatever the text inside them looks like.

name: unknown-shapes
source: Contract rule: Unknown fields. An unknown value keeps its kind: an empty list, an empty map, null, an empty string, a boolean, an integer, a decimal, and a string that looks like one.

name: every-field
source: 0030: the hash is of the section's content, and it excludes only source. A change to any field of any type, except source, changes the hash. Contract rule: Fields.
